comment: Labeled free lines for topic selection (the Jev spike, docs/JEV-SPIKE.md): what a player says to a resident, and the authored topic whose answer is the right reply (the label as story.available_topics gives it for a fresh player in the canonical world), or null when no authored topic answers the line (a greeting, a request, small talk, a topic word said in passing). Baseline: story.match_in_talk, the deterministic whole-word match. Authored at design time by the agent. set: dev may inform a threshold; held is never tuned on.
